issue_context.title: infinite error loop when trying to close window (`workspace::CloseWindow`)
issue_context.body:
### Check for existing issues

- [X] Completed

### Describe the bug / provide steps to reproduce it

_Warning: don't know if this issue fits on "Crash report" or "Bug report" because the program freezes / crashes, even though it keeps running._

First of all, I followed all the steps for building Zed on Linux following this [document](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/blob/main/docs/src/developing_zed__building_zed_linux.md).

Steps to reproduce the crash:

1. Open the editor (does not matter if it is on a file or not).
2. Press `ctrl+shift+w` for triggering `workspace::CloseWindow` event.

After doing it, the editor freezes and, if we see the terminal logs, here is what we got:

![image](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/assets/75737377/429fae15-0cb2-4fcd-945b-e318f3e4f1e7)

It only stops if `^C`

### Environment

Zed: `v0.132.0`

By running `uname -a`:

`Linux hicaro 6.6.25-1-MANJARO #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Thu Apr  4 20:32:38 UTC 2024 x86_64 GNU/Linux`


### If applicable, attach your `~/Library/Logs/Zed/Zed.log` file to this issue.

_No response_
comments: The problem still occurs on X11, I think this issue should have kept opened.
